extrasRate.filter: match_type T20/IT20, super_over=0, year >= 2019, event in the 13 engine leagues (franchise). T20Is are reported under bySource but not used: their women's wide rate is ~2x the leagues' because of associate-nation matches
extrasRate.perDelivery: wides>0 / noballs>0 / (byes>0 or legbyes>0) over all delivery rows

rain.source: Cricsheet matches/deliveries; pNoResult = result 'no result'; pReduced = reduced with a result: outcome_method set (D/L) or the chase's inn_target_overs < scheduled overs
rain.caveat: Cricsheet omits matches abandoned without a ball, so pNoResult is a LOWER bound for 'no result once started' only in the sense of fully washed-out fixtures; matches with at least one ball are included.
rain.whenRule: preMatch: first-innings legal balls == chase length (or all out within it); secondInnings: innings 1 ran full length or was all out, chase then cut; firstInnings: innings 1 stopped short of its length, not all out
rain.oversPerSideSource: all T20/IT20 reduced matches with a result and 6-ball overs, chase length rounded to whole overs

drs.source: Cricsheet JSON review objects (T20/IT20): decision is from the reviewer's side (batting: upheld = out overturned, struck down = out stood; fielding: upheld = not-out overturned to out). Overturned batting reviews and struck-down fielding reviews carry no kind, so they are split by the stood / upheld lbw:caught mix (umpire's call is lbw only).
drs.reviewsPerInningsRule: reviews (wicket-type, upheld / struck down, both sides) / regular innings, over matches with >= 1 review recorded; a match where DRS was available but unused counts as a non-DRS match, so this is slightly high
drs.keeperRule: caught review where the (non-substitute) fielder is the innings' wicketkeeper (fielding_player_innings.keeper_id); caught-and-bowled counts as not keeper

commentary.competitions: ESPNcricinfo commentary on disk is IPL only (2025 and 2026 seasons); all commentary rates are IPL-only

regex.fielding: (?:only|just) (?:three|3|two|2) fielders|too many fielders|fielding restriction|not enough fielders|(?:keeper|wicketkeeper) (?:standing|creeping|moved|was) (?:up |in front|ahead)|fielders? (?:was|were|is|are) (?:outside|out of) the (?:circle|ring)
regex.height: \bheight\b|\bwaist\b|above the shoulder|shoulder[- ]?height|head[- ]?height|over (?:the |his |her )?(?:batter's |batsman's )?head|\bbeamer\b|high full[- ]?toss|\bbouncers?\b|chest[- ]high|full[- ]?toss[^|]{0,60}(?:above|over)|third bouncer|second bouncer|short ball[^.|]{0,25}(?:over|above)
regex.frontFoot: overstep|front[- ]?foot|cut the return crease|return crease|foot (?:on|over|outside|just)|outside the (?:crease|wide line)

beamer.rule: no-ball with height keywords AND (pitchLength FULL_TOSS or 'beamer|full toss|waist' in text) AND no 'bouncer'; Jeffreys mean

shortRun.note: rate is the Jeffreys mean 0.5/(N+1) when none are signalled; Cricsheet does not record short runs
shortRun.regexSignalled: \b(?:one short|short[- ]run)\b[^.|]{0,25}\b(?:signalled|signaled|called|given|signals?)\b|\b(?:signals?|signalled|signaled|calls?|called|gives?|given)\b[^.|]{0,25}\b(?:one short|short[- ]run)\b|\bonly (?:one|\d) run (?:will )?(?:count|counts)\b|\b(?:run|runs) (?:is|are|has been|have been) (?:cut|taken off|deducted)\b

checkedSamples.text: Stolen two. Deep midwicket charges in and picks it up just past the ring but Sudharsan - who called early - makes it back in time. There is an ongoing check for a short run though... and Sudharsan did not get past the crease at the non-striker's. Stopped just inside despite reaching out with his body and bat. Was a length ball that was flicked softly
Patel gives himself room outside off stump by backing away. Malinga anticipates well and bangs one short on middle. A good bouncer which Urvil can't do much about

138ks full ball around off, driven with a big back-lift to long-off's right. Archer doesn't have to run much but the batters get two. Followed by a check for one short. Sudharsan the runner, was a few inches short as he slid late, makes it to the crease but doesn't cross it. Penalised

shortish again, just outside off. Dube cloths it to the edge of the ring in the mid on region, and Dube huffs and puffs to complete the second. There is a check for a short run but nothing doing on that count

fielding.source: ESPNcricinfo commentary, IPL 2025-26, 76 matches / 17587 balls. Drops, run-out chances and stumping chances use the feed's structured events (DROPPED_CATCH, RUN_OUT_CHANCE, STUMPING_CHANCE) against taken catches / run outs / stumpings (dismissalType 1 / 4 / 5); the rest are text regexes. Stumping and relay shares are thin (Jeffreys). Cross-check: CricViz T20 catch efficiency ~75-80% (drop share 0.20-0.25).

dropTextCrossCheck.regex: \b(?:dropped|drops|spilled|spills|shelled|shells|grassed|grasses|put down|puts down|muffs?|fluffs?|spurned)\b(?! (?:short|into|towards|down|the pace|it (?:short|into|towards|down)|his wrists|a hand))|\bdropped (?:by|a|an|the|another|that|this)\b|\bdropped[,!]?$|can't (?:hold|cling) on|cannot (?:hold|make it stick)|fails? to hold

regexes.bcatch: \b(?:deep[- ](?:mid[- ]?wicket|square(?: leg)?|cover(?: point)?|point|backward(?: square| point)?|extra(?: cover)?|fine(?: leg)?|third|mid[- ]?on|mid[- ]?off|midwicket)|long[- ]?on|long[- ]?off|long[- ]?leg|cow corner|third[- ]?man|sweeper|(?:on|at|near|inside|along|towards) the (?:rope|ropes|boundary|fence|cushion|line)|boundary rider|boundary (?:rope|fielder|line)|ropes?|fence|in the deep|of the (?:boundary|rope|ropes|fence))\b
regexes.relaySelfExclusion: by himself|all by himself|himself|on his own|all by (?:him|her)self

handCheck.note: precision judged by reading the seeded 'samples' of each item; re-judge if the regexes or the commentary corpus change

savedSix.note: low recall and mixed precision; treat as an order-of-magnitude figure

lodgedDeadBall.note: ball lodged between the batter's legs; the text does not say dead ball was called

shortRun.note: four 'check for a short run' mentions, none signalled

noBallKind.note: unclassified assigned to front-foot (the default reason); the 1 fielding hit is a genuine only-three-fielders call
